author: Warner Bros.
description:
Leonardo DiCaprio delivers a performance of remarkable depth as “Bob Ferguson” in ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER fully inhabiting the rich layers of Paul Thomas Anderson’s script. In moments such as the tense phone call about a rendezvous point, DiCaprio he balances urgency, humor, and vulnerability with effortless precision. Through his instinctive choices and collaboration with Anderson, he transforms Bob into a fully realized, living presence on screen, culminating in "his most inspired and relatable performance in years." 

Now nominated for 13 Academy Awards including Best Picture, Best Adapted Screenplay, and Actor in a Supporting Role.
title: Script to Screen: Bob's Phone Call | ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER #shorts

author: Warner Bros.
description: The cotton field sequences in SINNERS reflect a seamless collaboration between the Production Design and Visual Effects teams, uniting practical craftsmanship with large-scale digital innovation. Cotton plant lookalikes were used on set to ground Omar Benson Miller’s performance in tangible authenticity like his sharecropper grandfather experienced, while more than three million VFX plants were integrated to extend the landscape into a vast horizon. This carefully calibrated balance between physical and digital artistry not only achieved cinematic breadth, but also honors the lived experiences and personal histories that both Miller and Director/Writer/Producer Ryan Coogler brought to the narrative.
title: Behind the Visual Effects of SINNERS | Cotton Fields

author: Warner Bros.
description: The Juke Joint roof burn in SINNERS is a masterclass in mixing practical and digital effects. 50+ previs versions guided the actors’ movement and camera choreography to ensure the full oner worked in perfect harmony with Ludwig Göransson's score. The SFX team safely burned the roof on the real set while capturing it on multiple IMAX film camera, and the VFX team enhanced the scene by layering digital fire simulations, sparks, smoke, and drifting embers, creating depth and scale. Collaboration across Costume Design, Production Design, and Sound ensured that every detail, from textures to timing, felt authentic and immersive. Now nominated for a record-breaking 16 Academy Awards including Best Visual Effects.
title: Behind the Visual Effects of SINNERS | Surreal Montage
